    new_box = left, top, right + 1, bottom + 1
    new_boxes.append(new_box)

def count_stove_knobs(image_path):
    # Load the image
    detection = Object_Detector_Tool.load_model(model_size="tiny")
    detection.setModelType("tiny")
    labels = ["stainless-steel,stove", "stainless-steel,oven"]
    limits = {"stainless-steel", "stove", "oven"}
    detection.computeBoundingBoxes(image_path, labels)

    # Identify the stove knobs
    for label in labels:
        for limit in limits:
            detected_objects = detection.getAnnotations(image=image_path)
            for obj in detected_objects:
                if obj["label"] == limit and obj["confidence"] > 0.1:
                    for box in obj["bbox"]:
                        x, y, w, h = box
                        x_stove = x
                        y_stove = y
                        width_stove = w
                        height_stove = h
                        stove_knobs = y - y_stove
                        oven_knobs = x - x_stove
                        return stove_knobs, oven_knobs
